_comment: Detached two-bay garage beside 20 South Ave (OSM tags it 'house', but every photo shows a single-storey open-front garage here, 3.3 m NNE of house 248252370 across its driveway). Gable end to the road, ridge along u, black asphalt shingles; walls are bare OSB sheathing under torn white housewrap, concrete block base; two open bays with a centre pier, no doors. Road face -u; left (0) = -v = NNE. The cream house in the -v photos is the next house north, not this building.
